criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Get General Information
categories.definition: User asks for factual information, definitions, calculations, recipes, or general knowledge not related to personal data or specific media.

categories.name: Get Weather Information
categories.definition: User asks for current, past, or future weather conditions, forecasts, or weather-related advice.

categories.name: Get News Information
categories.definition: User asks for current events, headlines, specific news topics, or trending topics.

categories.name: Get Financial Information
categories.definition: User asks for stock prices, exchange rates, or other financial data.

categories.name: Get Location or Navigation Information
categories.definition: User asks for directions, locations, traffic, or travel times.

categories.name: Get Personal Schedule Information
categories.definition: User asks about their calendar events, appointments, reminders, or to-do items.

categories.name: Get Email Information
categories.definition: User asks about new emails, specific emails, or email content.

categories.name: Get Alarm Information
categories.definition: User asks about existing alarms or their settings.

categories.name: Get Business or Product Information
categories.definition: User asks for information about businesses (e.g., hours, services, order status) or product details.

categories.name: Get Media Information
categories.definition: User asks for details about currently playing media, artists, celebrity information, or upcoming media.

categories.name: Play Media
categories.definition: User requests to start, resume, or play the next item in a sequence of music, videos, podcasts, or audiobooks.

categories.name: Control Media Playback
categories.definition: User requests to pause, skip, or perform other specific playback actions on currently playing media.

categories.name: Control Smart Home Device
categories.definition: User commands to adjust settings or activate/deactivate smart home devices like lights, volume, or appliances.

categories.name: Send Communication
categories.definition: User requests to send emails, messages, or post on social media.

categories.name: Schedule Event or Reminder
categories.definition: User requests to add or modify an event, meeting, or reminder in their calendar or to-do list, or to set an alarm.

categories.name: Manage Lists
categories.definition: User requests to create, add to, remove from, or delete a list (e.g., shopping, to-do).

categories.name: Delete or Clear Personal Data
categories.definition: User requests to remove specific items or clear entire categories from personal data (e.g., calendar events, alarms, lists).

categories.name: Purchase or Order
categories.definition: User requests to buy items or order food.

categories.name: Book Travel or Transportation
categories.definition: User requests to book a taxi, train, or other travel arrangements.

categories.name: Prepare Food or Drink
categories.definition: User requests to make coffee or prepare a meal.

categories.name: Save or Add to Collection
categories.definition: User requests to save an item (e.g., song) to a personal collection or list.

categories.name: General Assistant Interaction
categories.definition: User engages in small talk, asks for jokes, expresses opinions, or makes general requests not fitting other categories.

categories.name: Search Web or Contacts
categories.definition: User requests to search the web for general information or find contacts.

categories.name: Summarize Content
categories.definition: User requests a summary of a document, book, or other content.

categories.name: Launch Application
categories.definition: User requests to open or launch a specific application.
